_comment: Per-station teaching lesson content. Loaded at runtime by OpenWorld::TryLoadLessonsFromJSON. Used to populate the Lesson Panel shown when the player presses E at a station during the Tour Quest. See docs/DEMO_GAME.md for the lesson authoring guide.

lessons.lessonText:
This station demonstrates Physically Based Rendering (PBR).

The engine uses the Cook-Torrance BRDF with three terms:
  • GGX Normal Distribution Function (NDF) — how rough the surface is.
  • Smith Geometry Function — self-shadowing microfacets.
  • Schlick Fresnel — reflectance at glancing angles.

IBL (Image-Based Lighting) contributes via a BRDF LUT, an irradiance
cubemap, and a prefiltered environment cubemap generated from a
procedural sky on CPU.

Final luminance passes through Reinhard tonemapping and gamma correction
before reaching the framebuffer.

This station demonstrates directional shadow maps and LDR bloom.

Shadow Map:
  • 512x512 D32_FLOAT depth texture rendered from light POV.
  • Depth-bias rasteriser state prevents z-fighting.
  • PCF (Percentage Closer Filtering) 3x3 tap via SamplerComparisonState
    in shadow_lit.ps.hlsl — produces soft shadow edges.

Bloom:
  • Bright-pass extracts pixels above luminance threshold.
  • Separable 5-tap Gaussian blur ping-pongs between two RGBA8 RTs.
  • Composite adds blurred result back with Reinhard tonemap.

This station demonstrates the procedural sky and weather system.

SkyRenderer:
  • Tracks a time-of-day clock (0..24 h compressed to real-time).
  • Computes sun direction from hour angle.
  • Interpolates zenith/horizon colour through Dawn, Day, Dusk, Night phases.
  • Generates a procedural sky cubemap on CPU each frame.

WeatherFx:
  • Smooth-lerp transitions between fog density, rain intensity, cloud cover.
  • State broadcast via EventBus<WeatherEvent> to audio, particles, terrain.

The full-screen sky triangle uses SV_VertexID in sky.vs.hlsl
— no vertex buffer required.

lessons.lessonTitle: Jolt Physics — Rigid Body & Character Controller
lessons.lessonText:
This station demonstrates the Jolt Physics integration (M5).

Key concepts:
  • PhysicsWorld (pImpl facade) wraps JPH::PhysicsSystem so Jolt headers
    are hidden from all public APIs (see physics_impl.hpp).
  • RigidBodyCreator creates Box / Sphere / Capsule bodies via
    JPH::BodyCreationSettings and adds them to the world.
  • CharacterController wraps JPH::CharacterVirtual — handles
    gravity (9.81 m/s²), step-up (0.4 m), slope-slide (50°), jump.
  • CastRay / CastSphere provide scene queries for AI and hit detection.
  • HitVolumeManager tracks AABB Attack/Hurt volumes for combat.

This station demonstrates the XAudio2 + X3DAudio audio system (M18).

XAudio2Backend:
  • Initialises X3DAudio after the mastering voice: X3DAudioInitialize().
  • Maintains a 16-slot source voice pool; WAV files are parsed inline.
  • Play(slot, path) / Stop(slot) / SetSlotVolume(slot, vol).

3D Attenuation:
  • SetListenerPosition() updates the X3DAUDIO_LISTENER each frame.
  • Compute3DVolume() runs the X3DAudio DSP calculation path;
    falls back to a linear distance formula when X3DAudio is unavailable.
  • Apply3DAttenuation() writes the result to the source voice.

AudioSystem (ECS):
  • Reads TransformComponent for every AudioSourceComponent entity.
  • Calls Apply3DAttenuation() per frame — distance attenuation is live.

lessons.lessonTitle: GPU Skeletal Animation — Skinning + IK Solver
lessons.lessonText:
This station demonstrates the animation runtime (M4 + M4b).

CPU pipeline:
  • Skeleton — joint hierarchy, bind pose, world-space transform chain.
  • AnimClip — keyframe channels, lerp/slerp evaluation per joint.
  • BlendTree — clip nodes + linear alpha blend.
  • AnimationSystem (ECS) — advances time, evaluates, writes AnimatorComponent.

IK Solver:
  • Two-Bone analytical IK (law of cosines) — foot placement.
  • FABRIK iterative N-joint IK — spine / tail.

GPU Skinning:
  • GpuSkinningBuffer uploads 64 joint matrices as a DYNAMIC constant buffer.
  • skinned_mesh.vs.hlsl blends up to 4 bone influences per vertex.
  • All in shaders/skinned_mesh.vs.hlsl + skinned_mesh.ps.hlsl.

lessons.lessonTitle: Behaviour Trees & Formation System — AI Architecture
lessons.lessonText:
This station demonstrates the AI systems (Post-M10).

Behaviour Tree:
  • BtTree owns a root BtNode and a shared BtBlackboard (key-value store).
  • BtSequence — runs children left-to-right; fails on first child failure.
  • BtSelector — tries children; succeeds on first child success.
  • BtCondition — tests a blackboard predicate.
  • BtAction — executes a lambda; returns RUNNING / SUCCESS / FAILURE.

FormationSystem:
  • LINE / V_SHAPE / CIRCLE slot layouts.
  • Greedy assignment of entity IDs to formation slots.
  • World-space offset transform per slot.

NavMesh (A* pathfinding):
  • Grid-based NavMesh baked from a 2D walkability array.
  • BakeFromGrid() / BakeEmpty() / SetWalkable().
  • FindPath() — A* with 4-dir + diagonal moves and obstacle routing.

lessons.lessonTitle: Quest System & Dialogue System — Data-Driven Narrative
lessons.lessonText:
This station demonstrates the quest and dialogue systems (M8/M20).

QuestSystem:
  • Reads quest_bank.json (shared/schemas/quest_bank.schema.json).
  • AcceptQuest / UpdateObjective / CompleteQuest / FailQuest.
  • OnEnemyKilled() / OnLocationReached() — event-driven hooks.
  • Fires UIEvent (SHOW_NOTIFICATION) and QuestEvent via EventBus<T>.

DialogueSystem:
  • Reads dialogue_tree.json — a graph of DialogueNode entries.
  • Proximity check (DialogueComponent.interactRange).
  • NPC stays at the current node until the player advances.
  • Triggered by ECS DialogueComponent — no hard-coded NPC data.

Lua callbacks: on_quest_accepted(questID), on_quest_complete(questID)
are fired from C++ and handled in scripts/quests.lua.

lessons.lessonTitle: World Streaming — Async Cell Load & Evict
lessons.lessonText:
This station demonstrates the world streaming system (M7).

WorldStreamingManager:
  • Delta load/evict coordinator — computes which cells enter/leave the
    load radius each frame.
  • SetMaxCompletionsPerFrame(n) — frame-budget cap prevents stutter.
  • DrawDebugOverlay(ImDrawList*) — colour-coded cell minimap.

WorldPartition:
  • Spatial grid: CellCoord, CellIdFromCoord, GetCellsNearPosition.

AsyncLoader (worker thread):
  • Single background thread + job queue.
  • CancelJob(cellId) via shared_ptr<atomic<bool>> cancellation token.
  • PumpMainThreadCompletions(maxCount) moves ready cells to the main thread.

GameStreamingManager (game layer):
  • OnLoadCell calls AssetLoader::LoadRaw + deserialises JSON.
  • OnCellLoaded calls Zone::SpawnEnemies/SpawnNPCs.
  • OnEvictCell calls Zone::Unload.

This station demonstrates the terrain rendering system (M25).

TerrainRenderer:
  • Two-phase init: LoadFromSamples/LoadCooked (CPU), CreateDeviceResources (GPU).
  • TRN1 binary format: 14-byte header (magic + H×W + cellSize) + float32 heights.
  • Builds a grid mesh with (width-1)x(height-1) quads from height samples.
  • Height-based colour blend in terrain.ps.hlsl.
  • Lambert + Reinhard tonemap for consistent lighting with the rest of the scene.

Terrain Collision:
  • BakeTerrainCollider uses JPH::HeightFieldShape (power-of-2 required).
  • Integrated into PhysicsWorld — walking on terrain uses Jolt physics.

Tool:
  • creation_engine.py bake-terrain: .terrain.json → .trn (TRN1 binary).

This station demonstrates the cinematic system (Post-M10 + M22).

CinematicSequencer:
  • Shot / cut timeline: Play(), Tick(dt), SkipToShot().
  • OnShotChanged / OnComplete callbacks.
  • AddAudioEvent(t, clipID) — timed audio dispatch; fires once per shot.
  • ApplyToCamera() — writes shot transform to CameraComponent.

CameraRig:
  • Keyframe list with world-space position/rotation.
  • Binary-search bracket + Lerp between adjacent keyframes.

Cinematic baker (tool):
  • creation_engine.py bake-cinematic: .cinematic.json → .cinematic binary.

Editor panel:
  • editor/src/panels/CinematicEditorPanel.hpp — timeline editor with
    shot/keyframe authoring and preview controls.

lessons.lessonTitle: Action Combat — ComboSystem FSM & Damage Formula
lessons.lessonText:
This station demonstrates the action combat system (M19).

ComboSystem FSM:
  • Three states: IDLE → BUILDING → COOLDOWN.
  • IDLE: waiting for first input.
  • BUILDING: collecting button sequence; times out if no input within window.
  • COOLDOWN: brief pause after combo fires before returning to IDLE.

Combo matching:
  • Prefix match — e.g. [A, B] triggers if the registered [A, B, C] starts here.
  • Exact match — [A, B, C] fires the registered combo completely.
  • Smart reset (plinking) — partial match that can't continue resets cleanly.

Damage formula: finalDmg = baseDmg * (strength / defence) * elementMultiplier

CombatConfig loaded from combat_config.json (ENGINE_ENABLE_JSON gated);
4 registered combos: Avalanche Chain, Warp Strike, Magic Burst, Phantom Sword.
